solutions.title: Memoized recursion
solutions.strategy: At each index, try a valid one-digit code and a valid two-digit code, caching suffix counts.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Memoization and recursion depth store up to n entries.

solutions.title: Bottom-up DP
solutions.strategy: Build counts from the end of the string toward the front.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP array stores n+1 suffix counts.

solutions.title: Constant-space DP
solutions.strategy: Keep only the next two suffix counts while scanning backward.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each character position is processed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only two future counts are retained.
